title: नकली Bank Agent vs वफादार कुत्ता 😱 | Dog Saves Grandma's Pension | Hindi Story
category: Wild And Domestic Animals Helping Humans In Their Life
hook_text: नकली बैंक वाला आया… पर मोती ने पहचान लिया!
look: Photorealistic live-action Indian television drama, shot on a cinema camera, natural skin texture, warm natural morning sunlight in a small North Indian town, shallow depth of field

characters.name: Kamla Devi

characters.face: thin, gentle oval face with deep laugh lines, warm dark-brown eyes behind round gold-rimmed glasses, wheatish-brown wrinkled skin, silver-grey hair in a low bun with a centre parting, small red bindi, slightly stooped, slim build, about 5 feet tall
characters.voice: an elderly woman's soft, slightly shaky, warm voice

characters.name: Ramesh
characters.role: con man pretending to be a bank agent
characters.face: sharp narrow face, thin trimmed moustache, small shifty dark eyes, medium-brown skin with light acne marks on the cheeks, short oiled black hair combed to the side, lean build, about 5 feet 8 inches, a fake polite smile
characters.voice: a smooth, fast-talking, falsely polite male voice

characters.name: Moti
characters.face: medium-sized Indian pariah dog with a short golden-brown coat, white chest patch, pointed upright ears, curled tail, alert amber eyes and a black nose, lean and athletic, a red cloth collar

characters.name: Constable Sunil
characters.face: broad square face, thick black moustache, kind but stern dark eyes, dark-brown sun-tanned skin, short greying hair under a khaki beret, sturdy heavy build, about 5 feet 10 inches

1.kamla: a plain off-white cotton saree with a thin maroon border, a grey woollen shawl, thin gold bangles
1.ramesh: a light-blue formal shirt, dark trousers, a black office bag and a blank blue lanyard card on his chest
1.sunil: a khaki Indian police uniform with a brown leather belt and a khaki beret

scenes.place: a small courtyard of an old North Indian house with a tulsi pot and a hand pump, morning
scenes.action: Kamla Devi lovingly feeds Moti a roti in the courtyard and talks to him
scenes.speaker: kamla
scenes.line: खा ले मोती, आज तेरी पसंद की रोटी है।
scenes.sound: Morning birds and a distant pressure cooker whistle

kamla.does: sits on a low wooden stool, holding out a roti to Moti with one hand and stroking his head with the other

moti.does: sits on the ground in front of her, taking the roti, tail wagging

scenes.caption_en: Eat up, Moti, today it's your favourite roti.

scenes.place: the wooden front door of the same house, morning
scenes.action: Ramesh stands at the open front door and tells Kamla Devi, who is in front of him, that her bank account is closing
scenes.speaker: ramesh
scenes.line: अम्मा जी, बैंक से आया हूँ, आपका खाता बंद हो रहा है।

ramesh.does: stands in the doorway holding up a blank white card

scenes.caption_en: Ma'am, I'm from the bank. Your account is being closed.

scenes.place: the wooden front door of the same house, morning
scenes.action: Kamla Devi reacts in fear to what Ramesh just told her
scenes.speaker: kamla
scenes.line: हाय राम! मेरी पूरी पेंशन उसी खाते में है बेटा।

kamla.does: clutches her shawl to her chest
kamla.expression: fear and shock, eyes welling up

scenes.caption_en: Oh God! My whole pension is in that account, son.

scenes.place: inside the small sitting room of the house, morning
scenes.action: In the sitting room, Ramesh leans towards Kamla Devi and asks for her ATM card and PIN
scenes.speaker: ramesh
scenes.line: बस अपना ATM कार्ड और पिन दे दीजिए, मैं ठीक कर दूँगा।

ramesh.does: leans towards her, one open palm held out, speaking softly and urgently

kamla.does: sits on the old sofa, listening

scenes.caption_en: Just give me your ATM card and PIN, I'll fix it.

scenes.place: inside the small sitting room of the house, morning
scenes.action: Moti jumps between Kamla Devi and Ramesh and growls at Ramesh, who backs away
scenes.sound: A low, menacing dog growl and a ceiling fan

moti.does: stands firmly on the floor between them, ears back, baring his teeth and growling

ramesh.does: jumps back a step in fright with both hands raised up in front of his chest, palms out
ramesh.expression: terrified: eyebrows raised, eyes wide, mouth open in fear, no smile at all
ramesh.face: sharp narrow face, thin trimmed moustache, small shifty dark eyes, medium-brown skin with light acne marks on the cheeks, short oiled black hair combed to the side, lean build, about 5 feet 8 inches

kamla.does: sits on the sofa behind the dog

scenes.place: inside the small sitting room of the house, morning
scenes.action: Moti leaps up at Ramesh, bites the plain blue card hanging on Ramesh's lanyard and yanks it off: the lanyard snaps and comes away with the card; Moti lands on all four paws with the card and lanyard in his mouth and turns towards the open door
scenes.speaker: ramesh
scenes.sound: A snapping cord and running paws on the floor

ramesh.face: sharp narrow face, thin trimmed moustache, small shifty dark eyes, medium-brown skin with light acne marks on the cheeks, short oiled black hair combed to the side, lean build, about 5 feet 8 inches
ramesh.does: stumbles backwards as the dog jumps at him and shouts; once the dog has pulled the lanyard off, Ramesh's chest is bare: no lanyard and no card on him
ramesh.expression: shock and anger, no smile at all

moti.does: leaps up with his front paws on Ramesh's chest, bites the plain blue card and pulls hard so the lanyard snaps; lands on all four paws holding the card and lanyard in his mouth, then turns towards the open door

wear.ramesh: a light-blue formal shirt, dark trousers, a black office bag, and ONE plain blue card with nothing printed on it, hanging on a thin blue lanyard around his neck (the dog pulls the card and lanyard off together)

scenes.caption_en: Hey! Give my card back, you dog!

scenes.place: a narrow sunlit lane of a small Indian town with parked scooters, morning
scenes.action: Moti runs fast down the lane towards the camera with the blank blue card held in his mouth

moti.does: runs fast down the middle of the lane with the blank blue card in his mouth, ears flapping

scenes.sound: Running paws on the street, distant traffic and a scooter horn

scenes.place: a narrow sunlit lane of a small Indian town with parked scooters, morning
scenes.action: In the lane, Moti has dropped the card at Constable Sunil's feet; Sunil holds it up and confronts Ramesh, who has just run up and freezes
scenes.speaker: sunil
scenes.line: अरे, ये तो थाने वाला फरार ठग है!
scenes.sound: A quiet lane, two loud sharp dog barks at the start

moti.does: stands at Sunil's feet facing Ramesh
moti.sound: barks sharply twice at the very start of the shot

sunil.does: holds up the blank blue card in one hand
sunil.expression: stern and angry, frowning, no smile at all

ramesh.does: stops running and freezes on the spot
ramesh.expression: panic and guilt, no smile at all

wear.ramesh: a light-blue formal shirt and dark trousers, a black office bag; NO lanyard and NO card on his chest
wear.sunil: a khaki Indian police uniform with a brown leather belt and a khaki beret; no lanyard, no ID card

scenes.caption_en: Hey, this is the conman the police are looking for!

scenes.place: the courtyard of the house with the tulsi pot, late morning
scenes.action: Back in the courtyard, Kamla Devi kneels and hugs Moti tightly with tears of relief
scenes.speaker: kamla
scenes.line: आज तूने मेरी ज़िंदगी भर की कमाई बचा ली, मोती।

kamla.does: kneels on the ground and hugs Moti tightly, kissing his head

moti.does: stands in her arms, licking her cheek, tail wagging

scenes.caption_en: Today you saved my life's savings, Moti.

scenes.place: the courtyard of the house with the tulsi pot, late morning
scenes.action: Moti sits alone in the courtyard, tilts his head and looks straight into the camera with big puppy eyes while a narrator talks to the viewer

moti.does: sits on the courtyard floor, slowly tilts his head to one side and looks straight into the camera lens with big, sad, hopeful puppy eyes
moti.expression: innocent and a little sad, ears soft

narrator.line: मोती ने तो दादी माँ को ठगी से बचा लिया… पर बेचारे मोती के लिए किसी ने अब तक Like और Subscribe नहीं किया!
narrator.voice: a young Indian woman's warm, playful, slightly teasing voice

scenes.caption_en: Moti saved Dadi Ma from the fraud… but nobody has liked or subscribed for poor Moti yet!
scenes.sound: Soft birdsong and a gentle, light-hearted music sting at the end

youtube.description:
एक नकली बैंक वाला अकेली अम्मा जी की पेंशन लूटने आया… पर उनके वफादार कुत्ते मोती ने सब बदल दिया! 🐕
A fake bank agent tries to steal a lonely grandmother's pension, but her loyal street dog sees through him.
